checks.name: Map, evidence, synthetic scope and responsive layout
Mobile navigation traps focus, closes with Escape and restores focus
Route excludes seeded hazard and handles disconnected destination
Report with image stays private, validates location and supports correction
Authenticated, privacy-reviewed publication changes route exclusions
Moderator logout preserves resident report ownership
Opt-in subscriptions and repeated-cycle alert deduplication
Storm, stale-feed outage, expiry and recovery preserve honest data support
Alert history distinguishes expired evidence and supports unsubscribe
Resident evidence withdrawal removes owned text and image
Synthetic model evidence, unpromoted candidate and offline API reference
Refresh failure retains the timestamped map and recovers
No uncaught JavaScript errors in the complete workflow
